rows.note: Flat 4.55% on all Nebraska taxable income for tax years beginning in 2026 (LB 754 phase-down: 5.20% in 2025, 3.99% from 2027).

sections.title: Nebraska property tax: state rules

rows.label: Levied by
rows.value: County government, school districts, cities, community colleges, natural resource districts and other local authorities (levies set by the county board of equalization by October 15)
rows.note: Each subdivision's rate = its budget tax request divided by its total taxable value.

source.title: Nebraska Department of Revenue: Nebraska Property Assessment FAQs

rows.label: State oversight
rows.value: Nebraska Department of Revenue, Property Assessment Division (directed by the Property Tax Administrator)
rows.note: Also administers the homestead exemption, the Property Tax Credit Act and the documentary stamp tax.

source.title: Nebraska Department of Revenue: Property Assessment Division, Purpose

rows.label: Assessment level
rows.value: Real property at or near 100% of actual value; agricultural and horticultural land at or near 75%

sections.title: Nebraska real estate transfer tax

rows.label: Documentary stamp tax rate
rows.value: $3.32 per $1,000 (or fraction) of the value transferred
rows.note: Raised from $2.32 on July 18, 2026 (LB 1067), which reverts the rate to $2.32 on January 1, 2032. Deeds recorded January 1 to July 17, 2026 paid $2.32.

source.title: Nebraska Department of Revenue: Documentary Stamp Tax Rate History

rows.label: Who pays the documentary stamp tax
rows.value: Grantor (seller), collected by the county register of deeds when the deed is recorded
